## Question

<!-- What we did not know, and what it was blocking. One or two sentences. -->

## How it was settled

<!-- The evidence, in descending order of strength. Say which applies:
     executed request / committed fixture + test / live session / reading the source.
     Reading the source is not verification - say so when that is all you have. -->

## Findings

<!-- What is now known. Lead with anything that overturned a previous belief,
     and with the things a reader would otherwise get wrong. Exact over vague. -->

## Where the knowledge lives

<!-- Required. An exploration is done when the knowledge is durable somewhere
     other than this issue - a wiki page, a doc, a skill. Link it. -->

## Still open

<!-- What was not settled, and what would settle it. "Nothing" is a valid answer,
     but an empty section is not. -->
